note: 采访牛顿的一天 (formerly 跟着牛顿过一天) sound plan, v5 (script v5 revision 3, gate 2; the v5 voice: A01 cut, G01 split into G01a / G01b; /home/user/newton_work/film/sound/REMIX_v5.md). at = [line id, 'start'|'end', offset s], [scene, 'from'|'to', offset] (the PICTURE's own scene bounds, voice.ts SEGMENT_RAW, so scene-anchored cues land on the cut) or ['card:<line id>', 'from'|'to', offset] (the picture's CARD_RAW). 'sync' = the moment of the ORIGINAL clip (s) that lands on 'at' (the rap, the stroke, the thud), default its 'in'. gain in dB, ONE static gain per cue (music is never ducked: no automation, no sidechain; fades only at a cue's own start / end). loop = repeat the clip to fill [at, until]; in = seconds skipped at the clip's start; len = seconds of the clip a hit plays; rate = sampler-style speed (pitch and length together); pitch = semitones, length kept (rubberband); hp / lowshelf / lp = ONE fixed filter for the whole cue. Clips: /home/user/newton_work/film/sound/clips (voice farm run newton-v4-sound-01; rec_beep from qin-sfx-01; sfx_poweroff and sfx_card_A5 made by make_poweroff.py / retune_clip.py; ph_* = PLACEHOLDERS made by make_placeholders.py, each cue naming its sound-farm request under 'placeholder'). Every cue's 'label' names the script cell it lands; SYNC_POINTS.md lists the picture frames. Levels: every line at least 10 LU over the bed (voice track vs the bed rebuilt with a silent voice) in the full band AND in the phone band (450 Hz-9 kHz); mono mix about -19 LUFS, true peak -1.8 dBTP (build.py --gain, --ceiling -1.8), under -1 dBTP after the AAC mux. Her camera: rec_beep on frame 1, sfx_poweroff when it switches off (G to - 1.4 s = hud/vlog.tsx OFF_AT). | r2 (14 Nov, the sound review's notes): build.py's limiter is on the VOICE branch only and the sum passes a safety limiter that never engages (the build refuses a mix over -1.8 dBTP); 'fade_curve' (qsin) for mus_supper's two-bar splice; remix_v5/tools/fix_r2.py lists every change and its note. | 14 Nov late evening (the effects plan's FULL gaps: G1 1.2 s after the thud, G2 2.5 s after B03 = Newton's card and its 75-frame freeze, G3 0.5 s after B09; 5438 frames): mus_morning -> mus_morning_v5 (one loop-back of 6 beats with a 40 ms crossfade, kept by the owner on 14 Nov, in the intro); the freeze stops B's room tone and the quill for 75 frames; skin A's sounds (labels 'skin A'); tools: remix_v5/tools/fix_gaps.py, make_mm_v5.py. | r3 (14 Nov night): tick 1's nib on a music onset (B09 end + 0.223 s), Humphrey's banner slip -15 dB; Newton's card's seal presses on f939, the morning music's A -> G major turn inside the freeze (the picture only).

whisper_dip.note: THE WHISPER (Jay, 14 Nov; bible 'Talking to the audience': the edges darken, the room sound dips): over each of the reporter's whispered asides THE ROOM dips 6 dB, down over 0.2 s ending on her first word, back up over 0.2 s from the end of her voice, both ramps kept inside the line's picture scene. The room is the ambience beds (group amb: amb_* clips) and the cues named in "also": sfx_quill (in Newton's room the room you hear is the quill loop; director, 14 Nov). v5: the lines are the picture's list (src/videos/newton/whisper.ts WHISPER_LINES: A03 A06 B09 D01 D05 E07, as the v5 table has them), the times the voice timing's; in v5 the dip meets the birdsong (A03, A06), the quill (B09, E07) and the hall's tone (D01, D05). build.py applies it as a gain envelope on those cues where they meet a window (exactly 1 outside the windows); music, voice and every other effect are untouched: music is never ducked.
